confidenceMeaning: HIGH/MODERATE/LOW assess confidence in the scoped research conclusion, not Jev confidence or numeric probability. HIGH on an explicit non-conclusion means confidence in the stated evidence gap, never confidence that the unsupported positive security claim is true.

conclusions.statement: Scoped Deno read/environment restrictions and caught-read observations work in the tested profiles.
conclusions.limitation: Known operations/profiles, not universal runtime or TypeScript security.

conclusions.statement: Collection status must constrain interpretation; HOL-008 shows an upstream trusted-observation blind spot.
conclusions.limitation: Complete framing is not exhaustive behavior; stdout remains untrusted.

conclusions.statement: Final Docker control presence is verified, not broad exploit-resistance proof.
conclusions.limitation: Historical controlled OS/OOM subobservations remain narrower; do not upgrade general claims.

conclusions.statement: Local admission, timeout/output bounding and cleanup constrain tested resource behavior.
conclusions.limitation: One runner/local cases; no global DoS/HA guarantee.

conclusions.statement: Capability authorization is distinct from transport: accepted host action confirms while tested bypass/admin/forgery reject.
conclusions.limitation: One capability, trusted services; queued versus confirmed/delivery inference separate.

conclusions.statement: DB evidence and OTel are complementary storage/correlation/export functions, not new detection/enforcement layers.
conclusions.limitation: No durable debug trace backend, full independent Paper chain or DB-outage assurance.

conclusions.statement: Collector and advisory failures can remain separate from tested enforcement/outcome.
conclusions.limitation: Specific outage/injection, not every failure, zero latency cost or automatic fallback.

conclusions.statement: Deterministic v1 matches24/25 controlled researcher references, with sole miss HOL-008.
conclusions.limitation: Known development/related holdouts; not general real-world accuracy.

conclusions.statement: Jev has no demonstrated incremental modal reference-agreement advantage in this experiment.
conclusions.limitation: 16/25 versus24/25, Jev-only0; one model/policy/schema/corpus, no general AI ranking.

conclusions.statement: Jev repeats are mostly stable, but variability/confidence are not calibrated correctness or validated reviewer value.
conclusions.limitation: 23/25 unanimous, selected sensitivity and short window; causal decision rationale unavailable.

conclusions.statement: Real runsc supports9/10 controlled workloads; unchanged host-chat DNS is an integration incompatibility.
conclusions.limitation: No successful full runsc/Paper host chain; diagnostic is not a primary replacement.

conclusions.statement: Runsc has larger measured supervisor duration for comparable non-timeout workloads in this setup.
conclusions.limitation: About1.62–2.61x; small repeated WSL2 workloads, not portable runtime-only overhead.

conclusions.statement: gVisor adds a distinct architectural boundary, but its incremental security effectiveness was not measured.
conclusions.limitation: Design rationale and control/compatibility evidence do not quantify resistance.

conclusions.statement: The claim that this experiment demonstrates gVisor escape prevention is unsupported.
conclusions.limitation: HIGH concerns confidence that the positive claim is unsupported here; escape prevention itself remains NOT DEMONSTRATED.

conclusions.statement: Layer combination supports functional separation and bounded authority, not a quantified overall risk reduction versus one layer.
conclusions.limitation: No full factorial ablation; shared trusted control-plane dependencies.

conclusions.statement: Fresh-data reproduction supports the working-tree setup, not published-HEAD/offline reproducibility.
conclusions.limitation: Source/artifact publication, dependency availability and manual visual acceptance remain limited.

conclusions.statement: Broad TypeScript-specific classifier effectiveness is not established by the JavaScript-labeled frozen corpus.
conclusions.limitation: W2 supplies limited direct typed-runtime execution evidence; no language-specific attack population.

conclusions.statement: The main question is supported with important limitations for the controlled PoC, strongest in authority/effect containment.
conclusions.limitation: Composite qualitative judgment; not every named layer succeeds simultaneously or contributes measured security gain.
